blocks.title: Virtualization
blocks.text: Virtualization lets one physical machine run several virtual machines, each with its own operating system and applications as if it were an independent computer.
It makes better use of hardware, reduces costs and makes management easier and more flexible: one computer is turned into many.

blocks.prompt: Why does virtualization save money for a cloud provider?
blocks.explanation: One powerful server can host many customers' virtual machines, so fewer physical machines are bought, powered and maintained.

items: Virtualization: one physical machine, many virtual machines.
